title: 'We leave it up to Singapore': No final South China Sea COC under PH ASEAN chairship
summary: No binding Code of Conduct on the South China Sea will be finalized under the ASEAN chairship of the Philippines, Foreign Affairs Secretary Theresa Lazaro said on Sunday.
